remarks: Welcome home to this spacious 2-bedroom, 1-bath first-floor apartment in Stamford's desirable Glenbrook neighborhood. Offering much more than your typical rental, this home combines comfortable indoor living, flexible bonus space, and outdoor areas you'll actually want to use. Inside, enjoy the ease of first-floor living with central air conditioning and gas heat, along with off-street parking and a designated washer and dryer for everyday convenience. And when you need a little more room, there's more waiting downstairs. A bonus room in the basement gives you the flexibility to create a home office, workout space, hobby room, or whatever works for your lifestyle. You'll also have additional basement storage-a welcome extra in apartment living. Then step outside and you'll see what really sets this home apart. Your attached private deck is ready for morning coffee, summer dinners, entertaining friends, or simply unwinding after a long day. Just beyond it is a large backyard, offering even more space to relax and enjoy the outdoors. And when it's time to head out, the Glenbrook Metro-North station is within walking distance, making commuting to NYC easy while keeping you close to downtown Stamford, shopping, dining, and major roadways. Two bedrooms. Bonus space. Extra storage. A private deck. Large backyard. Parking. It's a combination that's hard to find in a Stamford rental. Don't miss the opportunity to make it yours!
